wordmark.purpose: The KlausMate identity in light Garamond — sidebar and identity moments only; the system's one serif.

body.purpose: Default text; 600 weight for setting names and chips.

caption.purpose: Hints, statuses, row descriptions — always Ink Muted.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The dialog default — every button is primary unless it opts out.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #0071D3; color: #fff; border: none; border-radius: 8px; padding: 6px 16px; font-weight: 600; font-size: 13px; font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #0062C4; } .ds-btn-primary:active { background: #004990; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: The grey opt-out for cancel and auxiliary actions.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { background: #E5E5EA; color: #1D1D1F; border: none; border-radius: 8px; padding: 6px 16px; font-weight: 600; font-size: 13px; font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: #D1D1D6; } .ds-btn-secondary:active { background: #AEAEB2; }

components.name: Danger Button
components.description: Destructive intent, quiet until engaged: soft red ground filling solid on hover.
components.css: .ds-btn-danger { background: #FFEBEB; color: #D32F2F; border: none; border-radius: 8px; padding: 6px 16px; font-weight: 600; font-size: 13px; font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif; } .ds-btn-danger:hover { background: #FF3B30; color: #fff; }

components.name: Toolbar Chip
components.description: The chrome-bar link/button: transparent at rest, translucent veil on hover, byte-identical on the top and bottom bars.
components.css: .ds-chip { display: inline-block; background: transparent; color: #6A6A6F; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 8px; padding: 5px 12px; font-weight: 600; font-size: 13px; font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif; text-decoration: none; cursor: default; } .ds-chip:hover { background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.05); color: #1D1D1F; } .ds-chip:active { background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.09); }

components.name: Sidebar Nav Row
components.description: One row of the Preferences SettingsNav list; selection is a muted accent tint, never a solid block.
components.html:
General
Appearance
Semantic Search
components.css: .ds-nav { width: 172px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 3px; font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif; } .ds-nav-row { height: 32px; line-height: 32px; padding-left: 12px; border-radius: 8px; font-weight: 600; font-size: 13px; color: #1D1D1F; cursor: pointer; } .ds-nav-row:hover { background: #F0F0F0; } .ds-nav-row-selected, .ds-nav-row-selected:hover { background: rgba(0, 122, 255, 0.16); color: #0071D3; }

components.name: Settings Row
components.description: The SynapsePro settings row: bold name over muted description left, control right, hairline separators.
components.html:
Image crop
Right-click or double-click an image in a note field to crop a copy.
Bar blur
How strongly the top bar blurs an image behind it.
components.css: .ds-card { background: #FFFFFF; border: 1px solid #E5E5EA; border-radius: 12px; padding: 6px 16px; width: 420px; font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif; } .ds-row { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 16px; padding: 10px 0; } .ds-row-text { flex: 1; } .ds-row-name { font-size: 13px; font-weight: 600; color: #1D1D1F; } .ds-row-desc { font-size: 11px; color: #6A6A6F; margin-top: 2px; } .ds-row-sep { height: 1px; background: #E5E5EA; } .ds-btn-secondary-sm { background: #E5E5EA; color: #1D1D1F; border: none; border-radius: 8px; padding: 6px 16px; font-weight: 600; font-size: 13px; font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif; }

components.name: Search Field
components.description: The sidebar settings-search: quiet surface field, border-flip focus.
components.css: .ds-search { background: #FFFFFF; color: #1D1D1F; border: 1px solid #E5E5EA; border-radius: 8px; padding: 4px 10px; font-size: 12px; font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif; width: 168px; } .ds-search:focus { outline: none; border-color: #007AFF; } .ds-search::placeholder { color: #AAAAAA; }

components.name: Accent Swatch
components.description: A bare colour square — the swatch IS the label; selection is a white inner ring.
components.css: .ds-swatches { display: flex; gap: 6px; } .ds-swatch { width: 22px; height: 22px; border-radius: 6px; border: 2px solid transparent; cursor: pointer; } .ds-swatch-selected { border-color: rgba(255,255,255,0.9); outline: 1px solid #6A6A6F; }

components.name: Wordmark
components.description: The KlausMate identity: light Garamond over a muted version line — the one serif moment in the system.
components.css: .ds-wordmark { font-family: "EB Garamond", Garamond, "Apple Garamond", Georgia, serif; font-size: 18px; font-weight: 300; color: #1D1D1F; } .ds-wordmark-ver { font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, sans-serif; font-size: 11px; color: #6A6A6F; }

components.name: MD3 Switch
components.description: The on/off control for settings rows — MD3's track-and-thumb switch, drawn from theme tokens so it recolours under every accent preset. Replaces bare checkboxes.
components.css: .ds-switches { display: flex; gap: 16px; align-items: center; font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif; } .ds-switch { display: inline-block; width: 36px; height: 20px; cursor: pointer; } .ds-track { position: relative; width: 36px; height: 20px; border-radius: 10px; background: #E5E5EA; border: 1px solid #D1D1D6; box-sizing: border-box; transition: background 200ms cubic-bezier(0.2,0,0,1); } .ds-track-on { background: #0071D3; border-color: transparent; } .ds-thumb { position: absolute; top: 4px; left: 4px; width: 12px; height: 12px; border-radius: 50%; background: #AEAEB2; transition: all 200ms cubic-bezier(0.2,0,0,1); } .ds-thumb-on { width: 16px; height: 16px; left: 16px; top: 2px; background: #FFFFFF; }

narrative.overview: KlausMate dresses Anki the way a well-run clinic dresses a hospital: calm, sterile-clean Apple surfaces where nothing shouts, because the user — a medical student mid-exam-cycle — is already carrying enough stimulation. One hand-drawn star and one light-Garamond wordmark are the human pulse in the sterile field; everything else defers to the system. The entire look of every surface is a function of theme.palette(night): one token module, thirteen accent presets plus a custom colour, light and dark as parallel worlds with identical vocabularies. Controls are refined and restrained — visible but understated, answering interaction with soft tints rather than hard state flips.
keyCharacteristics: Apple system palette, light and dark, with identical semantic key sets
One accent family, user-selectable (13 presets + custom), overriding only blue-family tokens
Flat, hairline-divided surfaces; depth from tone and translucency, never drop shadows
Seamless frosted window chrome — top and bottom toolbars matching
One hand-drawn mark and one Garamond wordmark carrying the entire brand

rules.name: The One Module Rule
rules.body: No UI file hardcodes a colour. Every surface builds its stylesheet from theme.palette(night); an accent or theme change must reach every surface with zero per-surface code.

rules.name: The Blue-Family-Only Rule
rules.body: Accent themes override the six blue-family tokens and nothing else. Backgrounds, text, and greys never fork per theme.

rules.name: The Chrome Separation Rule
rules.body: Chrome is never the canvas colour: brighter than canvas in light, darker in dark.

rules.name: The Scale-Or-Drift Rule
rules.body: Only the sanctioned font sizes (10/11/12/13/14/18/24) and radii (12/8/6/7/4/2/0) exist; the test suite scans emitted CSS and fails on any other value.

rules.name: The One Serif Rule
rules.body: Garamond appears exactly once — the wordmark. No headings, no body text, no second serif moment.

rules.name: The Hard Geometry Rule
rules.body: Sidebar and row geometry comes from view properties (fixed heights, setSizeHint, layout spacing) — never from QSS-derived size hints. Navigation lists are ONE QListWidget, never per-item buttons.

rules.name: The Veil Rule
rules.body: On the chrome bars, state feedback is a translucent veil — rgba black over light chrome, rgba white over dark — never an opaque fill, so highlights tint whatever is behind them.

rules.name: The Byte-Identical Chip Rule
rules.body: Top-bar links and bottom-bar buttons emit the same shared declaration blocks, pinned byte-identical by tests. The two bars cannot drift apart.

rules.name: The MD3 Switch Rule
rules.body: A settings row's on/off is a track-and-thumb switch, not a checkbox. It is the one place MD3 language was deliberately adopted into the Apple-system world, and it must still draw from theme.palette() like everything else.

dos: Do build every stylesheet from theme.palette(night) and the shared builders; add new ids to dialog_qss rather than styling widgets inline.
Do ship BOTH palettes in one sheet for webview surfaces, keyed on Anki's night-mode classes.
Do disable and hide settings rows as whole units.
Do keep the accent reachable everywhere: any new surface must recolour under all presets + custom, both modes, with no code changes.
Do repeat the id selector in every :disabled rule that must beat an id-styled base.
Do use the MD3 switch (md3_switch.Md3Switch) for any settings row on/off — never a bare QCheckBox for that job again.
donts: Don't hardcode hex, font families, radii, or font sizes in UI files.
Don't use drop shadows; depth is tone, hairline, and frost.
Don't use opaque fills for chrome-bar hover states — veils only.
Don't box, fill, or iconify the star; don't introduce a second serif moment.
Don't build sidebar navigation from per-item buttons or derive control geometry from QSS size hints.
Don't fork backgrounds or text per accent theme, and don't let any accent state read as a loud solid block.
